summary: scripts/sync-pricing.ts: fetch OpenRouter /api/v1/models, upsert model_pricing rows; one-shot operator script + initial seed
description:
scripts/sync-pricing.ts — operator-run script.  Fetches https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models, finds the two models we use ('deepseek/deepseek-chat', 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5'), and upserts into model_pricing.

Algorithm:
  - GET /api/v1/models, parse JSON
  - For each (model_id) in our allowlist:
      - Look up current row in model_pricing where effective_to IS NULL
      - If pricing matches: no-op
      - If pricing differs (or no row): UPDATE old row SET effective_to = now(); INSERT new row with effective_from = now(), effective_to = NULL
  - Print a per-model summary

Field mapping (per OpenRouter response):
  pricing.prompt              -> input_price_per_mtok  (multiply by 1_000_000)
  pricing.completion          -> output_price_per_mtok
  pricing.input_cache_read    -> cached_input_price_per_mtok (null when absent)

Initial seed values to commit alongside (in case OpenRouter sync fails or is unreachable):
  deepseek/deepseek-chat:        input $0.14/Mtok, output $0.28/Mtok, cached null
  anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5:   input $3/Mtok,    output $15/Mtok,   cached $0.30/Mtok

Done when:
- ts script that runs via 'tsx scripts/sync-pricing.ts' (or 'npm run sync-pricing')
- Idempotent: rerun on unchanged prices is a no-op
- Documented: deploy/README.md routine for 'when prices change, run this once'
- Initial pricing seeded so child 5 has data to look up before the first sync runs
